title: Wonder
script: Number two. Wonder. A page framed in deep red holds a cloud of handwriting in black ink. It begins: As I laid there in my mother's womb, I wondered, is it really worth it? The writing runs on through growing up, school, marriage, children and growing old. In the lower left corner, a small figure curls up asleep inside a round womb. In the animation, the red frame floods with shifting pink, yellow and turquoise, and the curled figure is outlined in one bright color after another, while tiny flowers bloom between the lines of text.

title: Ovary
script: Number three. Ovary. A tall grey shape, drawn with dense pencil texture, curves over like a hook. At its top left sits a round, eye-like form, and below it hangs a glossy red bulb. A small green cell with spiky edges floats on the left, over a square of pale, stitched fabric. In the animation, the green cell drifts, and small colored dots, green, blue and brown, wander slowly across the drawing like cells under a microscope.

title: Girl
script: Number seven. Girl. A young girl with a black bob haircut sits facing us, her mouth open in a small red circle, her hands folded in her lap. Short red pencil strokes swirl around her like a halo. In the animation she closes her eyes. Her plain shirt fills with grey polka dots and a red heart appears on her chest. A ring of tiny flowers surrounds her, and the background glows with soft spots of yellow, pink, green and blue, above a band of rippling blue water.

title: Stamp
script: Number eight. Stamp. Black ink marks are scattered across a pale sheet: smudged stamps, small blots and fragments, densest near the top. In the animation, the marks gather into the outline of a koala clinging to a thin branch. A haze of green, yellow and orange spray blooms around it, and the koala shifts its grip and turns its head.

title: Hills
script: Number nine. Hills. Under a laser cut wooden panel patterned with small crosses, a sunset is drawn in soft pastel: an orange and pink sky over two green hills. Below it, handwritten lines begin: As we stood on the hillside watching the sun go down. In the animation, the sky shimmers with drifting color, light glints across the hills, and a tiny tree and figure appear on the hilltop as the day fades.

title: Oops
script: Number ten. Oops. A dark, furry animal with tall ears, something like a rabbit or a dog, sits on a strip of grass with one red eye. Above it, the word HATE is written in pink and red, with a small word, oops, between. In the animation, the word HATE multiplies, scrawled again and again in pink and red until it fills the sky around the animal, which sits still beneath it.

title: Hand
script: Number eleven. Hand. A faint pencil outline of an open hand, fingers spread, with dark painted nails and a thin bracelet at the wrist. In the animation, the hand fills with warm golden yellow. Its nails change color, orange, green and blue, dotted with tiny spots, and a small red heart hangs from the wrist. Around it, the word DADDY is written over and over in black, scattered with little red hearts.

title: Free Art
script: Number twelve. Free Art. On a pale yellow sheet, a small dark figure with three antennae holds up a flag. The flag reads FREE ART SCHOOL around a drawing of a face like a boombox. In the animation, the figure stands on a small orange mound, and the letters on the flag flash from one color to the next, pink, green, blue, as if the flag were waving.

title: Dress
script: Number thirteen. Dress. A dark, softly shaded silhouette of a dress, with no head, arms or legs, stands alone on grey paper. In the animation, the dress gains a body: a painted face in red, yellow and blue, black legs and bright orange shoes. Around the figure, the words NO COMMENT are stamped again and again, with tally marks and red patterns crowding in from the edges.

title: Tin Man
script: Number fourteen. Tin Man. A robot-like figure drawn in grainy pencil, with a funnel for a hat, a tall head and broad, boxy shoulders. Handwritten words float beside it: Don't you have laundry to do? In the animation, a red heart glows and beats in the figure's chest, its eyes light up green and red, small gears turn in the air around it, and the words appear one at a time.

title: Crown
script: Number seventeen. Crown. In faint pencil on pale yellow, a long-haired figure holds a bunch of balloons. Barely visible letters arc above it: Your crown will rust. In the animation, the words become bold, colorful sticker letters. A golden crown settles on the figure's head, then the scene turns black, tears fall, and a large yellow NO fills the frame.
